name: naive_bayes
label: Naive Bayes
brief: Fast probabilistic classifier. Good baseline for small datasets, text-like features, and when training speed matters. Supports Gaussian, Multinomial, and Complement variants.
when_to_use: Fast baseline classifier before trying complex models
Small datasets where other models may overfit
When training speed is critical (extremely fast to train)
when_not_to_use: When features have strong correlations or dependencies
When well-calibrated probability estimates are required
